numbering: Episodes numbered continuously across seasons as on Wikipedia: Season 1 is 1-23, Season 2 is 24-48 (its episode 0 counts as 24), and Season 3 Part 1 is 49-62.

arcs.name: Childhood
arcs.summary: A jobless shut-in dies and is reborn in a world of magic as Rudeus Greyrat, determined not to waste his second life.
events: Roxy Migurdia tutors the young Rudeus in magic, then leaves after he passes her exam.
Rudeus befriends Sylphiette, a village girl bullied for her green hair.
His parents send him away to the city of Roa to work as a tutor.

arcs.name: Roa: Tutoring Eris
arcs.summary: Rudeus becomes the live-in tutor of Eris, the violent young daughter of a noble house in Roa.
events: A staged kidnapping helps Rudeus win over the unruly Eris.
He trades lessons with the swordswoman Ghislaine.
A huge magical disaster during his birthday celebrations teleports everyone across the world.

arcs.name: Demon Continent
arcs.summary: Rudeus and Eris wake up on the distant Demon Continent with no money and no way home except a very long journey.
events: The feared Superd warrior Ruijerd saves them and offers to escort them home.
The three form the adventuring party Dead End.
The Demon Empress Kishirika gives Rudeus a magic eye that lets him see a moment into the future.

arcs.name: Great Forest
arcs.summary: After crossing the sea, the party lands in a beastfolk port and gets dragged into a smuggling plot.
events: Roxy just misses Rudeus as she searches for him.
Rudeus is jailed by the beastfolk after freeing kidnapped beast children.
The real smuggler is exposed, and the party waits out the rainy season in Doldia village.

arcs.name: Millis
arcs.summary: In the holy city of Millishion, Rudeus finally runs into a member of his own family.
events: Rudeus fights his father Paul, who has fallen into despair, until his little sister Norn stops them.
Geese helps father and son reconcile, and they agree to split up to search for the rest of the family.
Roxy returns to her home village and learns Rudeus passed through.

arcs.name: Central Continent and Shirone
arcs.summary: In the Shirone Kingdom, Rudeus learns that more of his family members are being held there.
events: Rudeus rescues his half-sister Aisha but is trapped by Prince Pax.
Zanoba and Eris help free him, and Lilia and Aisha can finally head home.

arcs.name: Return to Fittoa
arcs.summary: The long journey home ends, but not the way Rudeus hoped.
events: Orsted, the Dragon God, nearly kills Rudeus before Nanahoshi persuades him to stop.
Ruijerd leaves, and Rudeus finds the Fittoa region in ruins.
Eris leaves to train while Rudeus sleeps, leaving him heartbroken.

arcs.name: Guardian Fitz
arcs.summary: A side story showing what happened to Sylphiette after the teleport disaster.
events: Sylphie lands in the Asura Kingdom and saves Princess Ariel from an assassination attempt.
She becomes Ariel's masked bodyguard under the name Fitz.

arcs.name: The Brokenhearted Mage
arcs.summary: Crushed by Eris's departure, Rudeus drifts through the northern territories as an adventurer.
events: Rudeus joins the adventurers of Counter Arrow and rescues Sara from a blizzard.
Rudeus hits his lowest point and is pulled back by Soldat.
Prompted by the Man-God, he accepts an invitation to Ranoa University of Magic.

arcs.name: Ranoa University
arcs.summary: Rudeus enrolls at Ranoa University, where he meets a cast of strange classmates and the mysterious white-haired Fitz.
events: Rudeus researches teleportation with Fitz and the masked Nanahoshi.
Demon King Badigadi loses a duel to Rudeus and joins the school.
Fitz reveals she is Sylphie, and she and Rudeus become a couple and get engaged.

arcs.name: Married Life
arcs.summary: Rudeus and Sylphie start a household as more family arrives on their doorstep.
events: Rudeus and Sylphie buy a house and hold their wedding reception.
Paul sends Norn and Aisha to live with them, and Rudeus works to win Norn's trust.
Sylphie becomes pregnant just as a letter asks Rudeus to help rescue his mother.

arcs.name: Teleport Labyrinth
arcs.summary: Rudeus travels to the Begaritt continent to join Paul's party in a dungeon where his mother Zenith is trapped.
events: Rudeus reunites with Paul and rescues Roxy deep in the labyrinth.
Paul dies fighting a Manatite Hydra, and Rudeus loses his left hand.
Zenith is rescued with lasting memory damage.
Rudeus marries Roxy as his second wife, and his daughter Lucy is born.

arcs.name: Eris's Training (Mad Dog)
arcs.summary: The story turns to Eris and the training she began after leaving Rudeus.
events: Eris trains at the Sword Sanctuary, determined to become strong enough to stand against Orsted.
Ghislaine accompanies Eris as she pushes herself through brutal training under the Sword God.

arcs.name: Home Life and the Chaos Breaker
arcs.summary: Rudeus settles into life with his growing family while helping Nanahoshi with her plan to return to Earth.
events: Rudeus juggles home life with Sylphie and Roxy.
Nanahoshi's teleportation research reaches a new stage.
The group visits Perugius's flying fortress, the Chaos Breaker.

arcs.name: Turning Point 4
arcs.summary: An unexpected visitor brings Rudeus a grim warning about the future of his family.
events: An older Rudeus from a ruined future appears with his diary.
The diary shows Rudeus a tragic future for his family and the Man-God's role in it.
Rudeus resolves to protect his family, setting up a clash involving Orsted in Part 2 (due 2027).

filler.note: No filler: every episode adapts the light novels (the Eris OVA is not counted).
